Mary Curie Physical and Mental Health Rehabilitation Center

24 December 2021

Dear Mr. Collins,

Re: Mr. Peter Berry, DOB: 26/03/1991

I am writing to transfer Mr. Peter Berry, a-30-year-old accountant who has been treated at our hospital
for the past 6 months following a road traffic accident. Further care at your facility would be highly
appreciated.

(The patient’s past medical/family/social history can be written here as related reference is made in other
parts.)

On 26/06/2021, Mr. Berry was brought in to the hospital after a severe automobile collision. He had a
subdural hematoma and a right femur fracture and was managed accordingly at the emergency
department. Two days later, he underwent a surgical operation for his head and femur trauma.

During hospitalization, Mr. Berry was admitted to the intensive care unit where he was hemodynamically
stable. Four months later, till he became fully conscious. However, he still had difficulties with mobility
and speech. Therefore, physical rehabilitation and speech therapy was started. Two months later, he           Commented [OE1]: Use of note/short forms is
